metadata.disclaimer: 季节窗为规划示意，非实时交警/气象通告；出行前须核验当地路况与开园信息。
metadata.note: 供 GET /countries/CN/driving-context 与行程 metadata.drivingContext 使用。

windows.summaryCN: 雨季（约 6–9 月）康定—理塘—芒康段滑坡塌方高发，须预留缓冲日。
windows.summaryEN: Monsoon ~Jun–Sep: landslide risk on Kangding–Litang–Mangkang; keep buffer days.

windows.summaryCN: 冬春季垭口结冰/封路风险升高，核验交警通告并备防滑与保暖。
windows.summaryEN: Nov–Mar: pass ice/closure risk rises — verify police notices.

windows.summaryCN: 北线雨季塌方与绕行风险同级或更高，须预留缓冲。
windows.summaryEN: Northern corridor monsoon landslide risk — keep buffers.

windows.summaryCN: 新藏线非盛夏窗口天气更苛刻；非经验车队勿作默认行程。
windows.summaryEN: Outside peak summer, G219 weather windows are harsh — not a novice default.

windows.summaryCN: 独库公路通常仅夏季开放；须核验当年开园通告。
windows.summaryEN: Duku typically opens in summer only — verify annual opening notice.
windows.outsideWindowSummaryCN: 开园前/封路后勿排入默认可行日程。
windows.outsideWindowSummaryEN: Do not treat as feasible before opening or after seasonal closure.

windows.summaryCN: 冬春戈壁段低温、大风与部分景区淡季缩短开放，注意油料与保暖。
windows.summaryEN: Winter desert legs: cold/wind; some sites shorten hours — fuel and warmth.

windows.summaryCN: 滇西北雨季滑坡高发；进藏段叠加高原与检查站时间。
windows.summaryEN: NW Yunnan monsoon landslides; Tibet approach adds altitude/checkpoints.

windows.summaryCN: 秦岭/巴山段雨季落石与夜间山路风险升高。
windows.summaryEN: Qinling/Bashan: monsoon rockfall and night mountain driving risk.
